title: PROJECT JAMES — Local-First Graph-RAG with Adaptive Reasoning Budget (v0.3.1)
description: JAMES is a local-first, auditable knowledge reasoning system. v0.3.1 lands Direction 1 (Adaptive Budgeting) cycle closure with three publishable findings on gemma4:e4b: (1) cap budgets are a memory + safety + latency rail rather than a token-cost lever — the model naturally stops well below cap=4096 on every workload tier; (2) a 7-tier monotonic natural-stop gradient spanning 62 → 1681 tokens (27× dynamic range, cross-sweep noise <5% per tier) — the quantitative form of the workload-gradient sub-clause; (3) verify is a high-clustering cognitive stage (~12.5% unique baseline responses across 40 calls) — answer-convergence Mechanism 2 now has two axes (workload weight + task type). Plus a process finding: heuristic v2 (CAP_LIGHT 800 → 1200) was data-driven by a falsification → revision → confirmation cycle. The release ships TaskBudget module + experiment drivers + raw JSON measurements + result docs as a citable research artifact.
notes: Cross-stack validation artifact for the V3' Protocol v1 methodology spec (docs/research/v3prime-protocol-v1.md). Result documents under reports/promo-assets/v3prime-*-result.md present the Direction 1 / Direction 4 findings; raw JSON measurements under reports/research-runs/ are the underlying data. Three-author joint-piece collaboration with Robin Converse (Triava Labs, 26b MoE cross-stack) and Ali Afana (Provia, mid-June managed-Gemini cross-stack) is the next-cycle trajectory.
